features.description: Extract the dashboard's JavaScript/TypeScript ES module graph (relative imports) into as-built nodes + import edges, contract-stamped via the Plan A evidence contract. Unresolved (bare/vendor) imports surface as low-confidence unresolved endpoints, mirroring the Python crawler. Bounded to relative-path resolution; no bundler aliases, no type analysis.
features.acceptance: an extractor scans the dashboard ES modules and returns as-built module nodes (one per js file, source_path under the dashboard) plus import edges between modules whose relative imports resolve; an import that does not resolve to a local module is emitted as a low-confidence unresolved endpoint, not dropped; build_view_state includes these nodes/edges and they carry source_kind code with evidence_basis observed for resolved modules.

features.description: Lift the coverage ceiling: javascript is no longer reported as an unextracted kind (DontPanic now has a JS extractor), and the coverage block reports the new JS extractor's status (covered when js modules exist). A repo whose only previously-unextracted language was javascript can now rise above the low confidence ceiling.
features.acceptance: the coverage block no longer lists javascript under missing_extractors when the repo's JS is extracted, the JS extractor appears in the coverage extractors list with a status from the defined coverage statuses, and for a Python+JS repo with every extractor covered the confidence_ceiling is no longer forced low by javascript.
